# Unit tests the import graph cannot see (W07c, #10751). Shadow only today.
#
# When the queue narrows an overlap-area unit suite to `vitest related`, these
# still run whenever their area's suite is selected: they read files
# (readFileSync, readdirSync, globSync, fast-glob, import.meta.glob), import by
# a non-literal path, or resolve a URL against import.meta.url, so a change to
# what they depend on is invisible to the import graph.
#
# related-tests.test.mjs keeps this list closed over that scan: a new test that
# matches it fails lint until it is listed here (or, if it reads a fixed set of
# paths, mapped in path-reader-map.txt instead, which already runs it when they
# change). Remove a line when the test no longer matches; the test also fails
# on a listed file that does not exist.
#
# One repo path per line; `#` starts a comment.
